title: Kırmızı Başlıklı Tina ve Üç Kurt
author: Funda Nur Uşaklı
description: Tina is a book-loving Story Wanderer who moves freely between her favorite tales. On her way to deliver a cake to her grandfather, she meets three unusual wolves: one grumpy, one vegetarian, and one gentle giant. Instead of fearing them, Tina befriends them. When their mischief causes trouble, she uses wit, empathy, and courage to restore order. This playful, modern reimagining presents a heroine who shapes her own story and invites readers to rethink villains, celebrate imagination, and approach the world with kindness.
original_title: Kırmızı Başlıklı Tina ve Üç Kurt
english_title: Red-Hooded Tina and the Three Wolves
